points.text: GPU actor lighting and ground marks: actor sprites sample the shared light texture on the GPU at the feet (same origin/span/lod tap as the ground shader) and multiply the sticker by that value. CPU `LightRt.sample_xz` is removed from the actor hot path. Marks are near-black, low-alpha floor silhouettes whose sole positions and quad geometry are pre-baked in `actor_soles.json`. They live in a shared pool (starts at 6 nodes) that actors check out inside a light volume and return on exit. Hub uses one sun-driven mark; dungeon allows up to three (torches, crystals, campfires) with alpha split so they do not stack black. Static actors (dummy, vendor) no longer use `ActorLit`. Hub building shadows match their projected polygons again (hull-mask FINE_GAP band lowered from 200 to 165 so it no longer reads above the 0.75 inside cut and grows every shadow 0.1 m).

Mark-pool and script-size follow-through: reparent into the pool with `false` so a mark never reads a global transform after its actor leaves the tree. `actor_lit.gd` split under 10 KB (mark pool and tick into `actor_lit/lit_pool.gd` and `lit_tick.gd`).

Headless local-AI tuner and campaign: the loop no longer stalls before decide rows. On a headless display `wait_painted` yields one process frame instead of waiting for the never-emitted `frame_post_draw`. Decide-row counting deduplicates against the spool. A headless run produced 1924 new rows; the resulting policy scored 199/383 held-out and 22/383 on the scripted ladder. Campaign walker now paths to the living guardian, opens doors, and takes stairs after the guardian dies; one weapon worn per run with next-weapon selection by lowest performance; floor-5 clear stored per weapon. P6 smoke survives Loadout’s real dungeon entry under the same headless wait. Wander falls through when a guardian or stairs exist; interact press uses the chosen prop instead of the nearest pickup stealing it.

Consumables on the live stat path: food and potion stat bonuses (`bonus_id` / `bonus_amt` / duration) flow through `App.gear()` via `consumable_bonus()`. Timed food (while heal-over-time is active) and potion (while its timer runs) add to derived stats. HP bonuses refresh max HP on apply and expire; the move-speed cache also watches active consumables.

Dungeon geometry and map edges: `outline.gd` split (seal/gap into `outline_seal.gd`); `mesh_span.gd` split (joins into `mesh_span_join.gd`, bevels into `mesh_span_bevel.gd`). Straight-span edge marking shared between `outline_seal` and `map_rim` via `edge_mark.gd`. Fixed-expectation edge/seal/rim fixtures added (`perf.py map --fixtures`). `Dungeon.walls` chain and the `torch_ms` metric removed (torch facing is assigned once at placement).

Debug surfaces and tools: `debug.playtest` split into `playtest` (AI sim walker / recommended config) and `bench` (hub/dungeon/perf-sweep). Report Bug UI files and shared helpers named in the UI docs. Inventory gains its own code-map row. Routes bind the wall pipeline and the light_rt shared write. `lint.py unused` gained a multi-line string lexer, inner-class scopes, file/module-aware dead-code graph, verified `--apply`, and refuses property-block vars; verified-unused code removed from visual-review paths; nightly advisory unused sweep added. `review_hook --nope` fixed; perf_sweep hub claim corrected.

Process, docs, and parked work: compact stops named “safe” (before Prove or a follow-up Gather/Change). `find.py changed --prior-week` lists seed-to-seed diffs. Build pickup starts at `slice.py start` + pc-offload. AGENTS.md brought under its 3350-byte boot budget. Contradictions, dated lines, and read_when drift cleaned. `shot-catalog-gaps` task closed. Unfinished female modular-voxel mannequin (build script, cells, blend, keyed parts, review shots) saved under `_src/wip/modular-voxel-walk/` for next week.

entries.summary: Grok Build Week 11 — GPU actor lighting and shared mark pool, headless AI tuner and campaign unblocked, consumable bonuses on the live stat path, dungeon/map edge and wall-pipeline cleanup with script splits under 10 KB, playtest/bench split, lint unused-code improvements, and the unfinished female voxel mannequin parked for next week.
